title: CTW-adviser · Phase 2 inspection
description: Read-only roster, native definitions, relationships and provenance. Source: CTW-data 3b5d13d94c5ed3eb4b9c6ce61cc75854b4426196. Activated abilities retain bounded metadata; coverage_gaps records unresolved semantics.

unit_profiles.description: 2,409 distinct unit profiles. faction_name is a list; faction-specific restrictions and original source locators are linked in unit_availability (3,181 records).

unit_availability.description: Original faction/subculture-qualified availability, restrictions, notes and provenance. Shared inclusion does not transfer recruitment permissions.

unit_roster_records.description: Lossless reconstruction of the 3,181 original source roster records; repeated combat statistics are stored once in unit_profiles.

coverage_gaps.description: Known limits in the retained native definitions; these are not inferred combat effects.

source_files.description: Locked source paths and byte hashes used to build this snapshot.

find_units.title: Find units by name
find_units.description: Enter part of a unit name, such as Kroxigor. An empty name shows the roster.
find_units.sql: select unit_name, unit_key, faction_name, tactical_category, entity_count, total_hp, armour, melee_attack, melee_defence, weapon_base_damage, weapon_ap_damage, speed, multiplayer_cost from unit_profiles where unit_name like '%' || :name || '%' order by unit_name, unit_key
